title: Can't Tell Me Nothing [Alternate Music Video]
description: On July 25, 2007, West premiered an alternate music video for "Can't Tell Me Nothing" on his website. This version was directed by Michael Blieden and featured comedian Zach Galifianakis and folk singer-songwriter Will Oldham. West had been introduced to Galifianakis' work through his personal trainer, and eventually asked him to perform in his second video after attending one of Galifianakis' stand-up shows in Los Angeles. The unscripted, low-budget music video was filmed at Galifianakis' farm in North Carolina and features him and Oldham lip-synching to the song. The alternate video was selected by Rolling Stone as the third best music video of 2007 while Pitchfork cited the version as thirtieth best music video of the decade.

description: The adidas Yeezy Quantum Infants ‘Frozen Blue’ presents a vibrant colorway of Kanye West’s futuristic basketball-inspired sneaker, scaled down and simplified for little feet. No-tie laces secure an a layered knit jacquard upper, enlivened with flowing blue lines that extend from the synthetic suede toe cap to the black neoprene heel/collar. A seamless heel counter extends to the caged Boost midsole, supported by a herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

title: YEEZY DESERT BOOT
description: The adidas Yeezy Desert Boot ‘Taupe Blue’ marks the first iteration of the chunky silhouette to stray from a monochromatic color scheme. A vibrant blue finish stands out on the high-traction rubber outsole and midsole, while the Yeezy 500-inspired upper is rendered in neutral tan and brown hues. Breathable mesh is bolstered with leather and suede overlays, along with stacked eyelets and a high-cut padded collar. Exterior branding is limited to an adidas logo stamped on the outsole.
